title: The B1 multi-view collapse: five legacy-modern pairs proved identical, inverses not

upstream_anchor.section: The multi-view collapse (battery B1, 829 probes, build 20131)

status_plain: Across 829 probes on build 20131, five legacy surfaces were shown to publish the same bits as their modern counterparts. That is what licenses treating a figure measured on CHIDIST as relevant to CHISQ.DIST.RT -- but the figure was still measured on CHIDIST, and none of these five surfaces is credited with a count here. The limit matters and the source states it precisely: the collapse covers the five FORWARD CDFs only. No inverse pair is proven identical anywhere in OxFunc, so no *INV figure may ever be sibling-inherited -- GAMMA.INV's 18 of 60 may not be placed on GAMMAINV, and the same holds for CHIINV, BETAINV, FINV and TINV against their modern counterparts.
